rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when an action is done unnecessarily.

example.english: You don't need to arrive superfluously early for the meeting; coming a little later is fine.
example.traditional: 你冇必要咁早返嚟開會，遲少少都冇問題。
example.jyutping: nei5 mou5 bit1 jiu3 gam3 zou2 faan1 lai4 hoi1 wui2 ci4 siu2 siu2 dou1 mou5 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this when the extra action or detail is itself redundant.

example.english: You explained it superfluously; everyone understood it already.
example.traditional: 你多餘咁再解釋一次，大家一早都明喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 do1 jyu4 gam3 zoi3 gaai2 sik1 jat1 ci3 daai6 gaa1 jat1 zou2 dou1 ming4 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the unnecessary action is also pointless or not worth doing.

example.english: They kept arguing superfluously over such a small matter; it was not worth it at all.
example.traditional: 佢哋無謂咁為咗呢啲小事拗落去，完全唔值得。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 mou4 wai6 gam3 wai6 zo2 ni1 di1 siu2 si6 aau3 lok6 heoi3 jyun4 cyun4 m4 zik6 dak1
